blocks.text: The Philippines has more companies on the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For™ Southeast Asia 2026 list than any other country, with 54 companies certified in the Philippines named in the ranking released today by Fortune and Great Place To Work®. Philippine employers lead from the front. Golden Arches Development Corporation enters at #7, and Balibago Waterworks System (#19) and Megaworld Corporation (#22) follow inside the top 25. Now in its second year, the Southeast Asia list builds on Fortune’s 100 Best Companies to Work For, which has drawn on Great Place To Work’s workplace research in the U.S. since […]...
